description: Source code for the VBRISeeker class, which handles seeking within MP3 files using VBRI headers, including parsing header data, calculating duration, and determining byte offsets for specific times.

classes.name: VBRISeeker
classes.description: Class for parsing VBRI headers in MP3 files to facilitate seeking and duration calculation.

methods.name: VBRISeeker::CreateFromSource
methods.description: Factory method to create a VBRISeeker instance by reading and parsing a VBRI header from a data source.

methods.name: VBRISeeker::getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the MP3 file in microseconds if available.

methods.name: VBRISeeker::getOffsetForTime
methods.description: Calculates the byte offset in the file corresponding to a given playback time.
